facts.fact: Kenya's ICT Cabinet Secretary William Kabogo, through the Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, invited citizens, researchers, academia, industry, civil society, innovators and the private sector to comment on the Draft Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy, with the consultation open until 4 August 2026 (date given is the article's publication date, 2026-07-28, as the invitation date is not stated).
